name: DevFest Kochi '26
theme: Build, Secure, Scale: developers and builders in the agentic era.
aboutTitle: The world's largest community-driven tech conference, in Kochi.
about: DevFest events are independently run by local Google Developer Groups and designed for developers and AI builders everywhere, packed with the latest Google technologies, industry trends, hands-on workshops and networking. DevFest Kochi is GDG Cochin's edition: an all-day developer conference of talks, sessions and workshops at Infopark, Kochi.
